test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that represents the letters which, when sequentially placed from left to right in the blanks below, will

complete the letter series.

f d _ e _ e f _ d d _ d _ f f _ d _ d _ f

options.text: d d f e e d e d
d d f e f d e e
d d f d e d e f
d d f e e d e e

solution:
Given series: f d _ e _ e f _ d d _ d _ f f _ d _ d _ f

Option 1) d d f e e d e d → f d __d__ e __d__ e f __f__ d d __e__ d __e__ f f __d__ d __e__ d __d__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 2) d d f e f d e e → f d __d__ e __d__ e f __f__ d d __e__ d __f__ f f __d__ d __e__ d __e__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 3) d d f d e d e f → f d __d__ e __d__ e f __f__ d d __d__ d __e__ f f __d__ d __e__ d __f__ f → (It doesn't follow any pattern)

Option 4) d d f e e d e e → f d __**d**__ e __**d**__ e f __**f**__ d d __**e**__ d __**e**__ f f __**d**__ d __**e**__ d __**e**__ f → (It follows the pattern of: fddedef - fddedef - fddedef)

Hence, "Option 4" is the correct answer.
